english_title: Inequality Form of the Summation for r > 1
statement_en:
If $r>1$, then
$$\sum_{k=1}^n k^{-r}=\zeta(r)+\frac{1}{1-r} n^{1-r}+\frac{1}{2} n^{-r}-\frac{r}{12} n^{-r-1}+E_r(n),$$
where the remainder satisfies
$$|E_r(n)|<\frac{r(r+1)(r+2)}{720n^{r+3}}.$$
final_code:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

theorem zeta_partial_sum_euler_maclaurin
    (ζ : ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 1 < r) :
    ∃ E : ℕ → ℝ,
      ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
        (Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun k => Real.rpow (k : ℝ) (-r)) =
            ζ r
              + (1 / (1 - r)) * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) (1 - r)
              + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) (-r)
              - (r / 12 : ℝ) * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) (-r - 1)
              + E n)
          ∧
          |E n| < (r * (r + 1) * (r + 2)) / (720 * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) (r + 3)) := by
  sorry
